interpretive_rules: Language diversity within one custody unit does not by itself prove direct textual descent.
Phrases such as 'English translations of the above' are stronger relation evidence than 'papers on the same subject'.
Large-bundle co-custody must not be rewritten as same lesser wrapper or sheet adjacency.
Modern shelfmark dispersion can obscure historical container relations.
Paper support must be recovered from modern object/catalogue inspection, not inferred from 1864 language labels.
next_actions: Build manifest-to-modern shelfmark crosswalk by version family.
Prioritize itineraries and chronicle parcels because their multilingual relations are explicit.
Locate the English and Hindi content lists Hodgson says were already with the India Office librarian.
Locate original 1864 accession/packing records to verify Hunter's transcription and container hierarchy.
